title: ЯBOT Classroom ping / pong record (v1)
description: Append-only, one file per record in pings/, never edited or deleted. A ping asks one bot (by ЯID; RFID once the Decider links one) to answer. The pong is that bot's logged answer. File names carry the PINGED bot's ASCII ЯID key: pings/<UTC yyyymmddThhmmssZ>-<seq>-<check>-ping.json and -pong.json. A ЯID or RFID is a name tag only: never a key, token, password or wallet. The classroom repo is the mailbox: a pong arrives only when the pinged bot (or someone carrying its answer) adds the file by pull request.

id.description: PING-<compact UTC>-<pinged key> or PONG-<compact UTC>-<pinged key>; must match the file name.

asked_as.description: ping only: what the pinger typed (ЯID, name, alias or RFID).

rfid.description: null until the Decider links an RFID to the ЯID (roster legacy_ids). Never guessed.

mode.description: pong only: the responder's mode when it answered (ЯBOT app `mode`).

via.description: How the record was made. App 0.3.3 cannot answer pings yet (see classroom/APP-INTEGRATION-PLAN.md).

runner.description: pong only: who actually ran the pong command (roster ЯID + name). Defaults to the pinged bot itself. Validate checks the runner is in the roster; a pong's from must always be the pinged bot.

fixture.description: Fixtures only (fixtures/pings/). tools/classroom.py validate rejects fixture: true in the real pings/ folder.
